text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's the last one!
Everyone, thank you so very much!”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal~!
The food here really is a cut above the rest, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! I'm really looking forward to seeing what kind of dishes you'll cook next~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Everyone who came by
went home with a totally 'buono' smile on their face!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They ate every last bite...!
Nothing could make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That just means we grew delicious veggies and came up with great recipes for 'em.
Heh-heh, we're total aces in the kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep defending it!
Our spot at the top!"

Amidst high praise, the food prepared was completely cleaned off the plates.
For a producer, there could be no greater reward.
